title: "Parking Management"

## Dixon Resources Unlimited Contract

The City contracted with Dixon Resources Unlimited to develop a Parking Management Action Plan.

**Contract timeline documented:**
- Original contract executed: December 5, 2024
- Amended: March 18, 2025
- Amendment No. 1: April 30, 2026 — signed the day the original contract expired, with no stated reason found for the delay

**Status per the FY2026-27/FY2027-28 biennial budget (Community Development Department accomplishments):** "Completed data collection and existing conditions report. Alternatives are under development in preparation for community review and feedback."

::: {.source-note}
Source: Dixon Resources Unlimited contract documents (12/5/2024, 3/18/2025, Amendment No. 1 4/30/2026); FY2026-27/FY2027-28 Biennial Budget.
:::

## Parking Management Infrastructure (Capital Project)

A separate, funded capital line item:

| Fiscal Year | State Grant Funding |
|---|---|
| FY2028 | $600,000 |

::: {.source-note}
Source: FY2026-27/FY2027-28 Biennial Budget, State Grant (secured) funding table.
:::

## Outstanding Questions

- No document yet reviewed states why Amendment No. 1 was signed on the exact day the original contract expired, or what the gap in coverage (if any) meant for the project.
- The relationship between "alternatives under development" (as of this budget document) and any specific timeline for community review has not been confirmed.
